editsUnticked: In the app, changes to existing items ({count}) start unticked — the owner accepts them one by one or with "Accept all". This check assumes all are accepted.
againstEmptyBase: Checked against an empty knowledge base (no base given): references to entries that already exist are not checked.
againstBase: Checked against the knowledge base "{name}" as its AI snapshot shows it: {entries} entries, {kinds} entry types, {docs} other items (views, templates, flows …).
idsLost: {count} items of the base could not be rebuilt with their ids for this check — a change to them by id may show as new here.
againstEmpty: Checked against an empty state: the form, the values and how the document fits together are checked; whether ids it names exist is shown only by the preview in the app.
againstNewPage: Checked as a new page (as the page preview does); a page that already exists keeps what the document does not name.
formAsPage: The form module is checked as a page with this one module.
againstNewArea: Checked as a new area that you lead, under a sample address.
communityRead: The community tree reads without errors.
communityNote: Checked as the document reads; what it would change in an existing community is shown by the preview in the app.
sampleWork: Checked for a sample work (the app uses the chosen work).
notScheme: This is not a scheme of appointments.
notPlan: This is not a plan of a calendar.
entriesNote: Checked with the questions the list itself names (the app uses the questions of the chosen form).
personsNote: Checked without the persons of the account: the app matches persons by their "id".
rolesNote: Checked for an account with one person (you, "@ja") who leads: the other roles of the account are not known here — the preview in the app checks against them.
